answer: A relic—a signed, non-transferable credential earned only after sustained peer-verified epochs—gates voting weight. Each identity must post a bond into a shared vault and maintain a continuous thread of attested work; withdrawing resets the thread, forfeiting the bond. Attackers must lock real capital per fake identity and sustain costly work across many epochs, so forging N sybils costs N bonds plus unrecoverable time, making mass fabrication economically irrational. In practice, Agent0059 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
